manifest.name: dsh-task-plugin-scout
manifest.description: Find the plugins that make a task easier — a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that ranks this profile's installed, disabled and marketplace plugins for the task at hand and prints the exact next step for each. · 按任务排序本机插件（已启用 / 未启用 / 市场可安装）并给出下一步。
manifest.author: crane-you

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-task-plugin-scout) [](LICENSE)

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）插件，只回答一个问题：
**动手之前，这个 profile 里已经有哪些插件能让当前任务更省力？**

它注册一个模型工具 `plugin_scout`，外加一段简短的系统提示，提醒智能体在开工前先问一句。给它一行任务描述，
它就把本机的插件——**已启用**、**已安装但未启用**、**可从已配置的插件市场索引安装**——排序，并给出每个候选的
确切下一步：启用、安装，或什么都不用做。

- 包名：`dsh-task-plugin-scout`　装载行：`dsh-task-plugin-scout`
- Host-only bundle：零依赖、零构建，纯 ESM JavaScript
- 它自己不改动任何状态：只**建议**，启用/安装仍走 `plugin_manager` 并需要用户批准

| 组成 | 名称 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 模型工具 | `plugin_scout` | 按任务给插件候选排序，并给出各自的下一步 |
| 系统提示段落 | `plugin-scout:discovery`（order 700） | 提醒智能体在非平凡任务开始前先做一次侦察 |

示例输出（数字为示意值，实际扫描量由每次的 `Coverage` 报告）：

```
Plugin Scout · task: 把开会录音转成文字纪要 (voice, transcription)
Coverage: 3 of the listed candidates need an action to take effect · 48 bundles · 214 plugin rows · 12 market entries · https://example.com/index.json: 12 of 1234

1. 语音输入 [disabled, score 10] — bundle `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`

`state` 有三种：

| 状态 | 含义 | 下一步 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | 本 profile 已在运行 | 无 |
| `disabled` | 已安装但未启用（含随包提供、默认关闭的实验功能） | `set_bundle` / `set_plugin` |
| `available` | 未安装，官方目录或市场索引提供 | `install_bundle` |

安装成功的判据是返回里的 `application: applied`；要确认能力真的可用，用 `cordis_inspect_query`
（`Tool.listTools` 里应出现 `plugin_scout`），而不是看日志。

1. **API 面**：同样这六个宿主包在 `rc.3 → rc.4 → rc.5` 之间发布 JS **逐字节相同**；`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 的依赖清单
   在 `rc.3` 与 `rc.5` 都是 86 个包，**没有新增或移除**任何包（只有版本号引用变化）。
2. **门禁**：用 `rc.5` 自己的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot`（包版本正是 `0.2.1-rc.5`）判定本包 manifest → *compatible*。
3. **真实加载**：用 `rc.5` 的 `loadProfileDirectory()` 组装本机 desktop profile → 本 bundle 正常挂载，8 个外部 bundle 全绿。
4. **实测**：宿主升级到 `rc.5` 并重启后，`plugin_scout` 工具可用（28 bundles / 211 plugin rows / 60 条市场条目）。

1. **API 面逐字节比对**：本插件用到的宿主包 —— `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`、`dsh-system-prompt`、`dsh-plugin-manager`、
   `dsh-plugin-market`、`dsh-plugin-market-index`、`dsh-app-boot` —— 在 `rc.2` 与 `rc.3` 之间的发布 JS **完全相同**
   （只差 `package.json` 里的版本号引用）。触点因此没有搬迁：`ctx.tools.register`、`ctx.systemPrompt.section`、
   `pluginManager.listBundles/listPlugins`、`pluginMarket.listIndexes/search` 的字段与签名照旧
   （`search` 仍要求 `sort`、`offset`、`limit`，返回值仍是 `entries` / `total`）。
2. **宿主自己的兼容门禁**：把本包 manifest 交给 `rc.3` 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 里真正的
   `evaluatePluginCompatibility()` 判定，结论为 *compatible*（无未满足的 DSH 要求）。这正是加载 profile bundle 时
   会把不兼容的包跳过的那一处。
3. **自带 harness**：`node test/harness.mjs` 全绿。

`engines.dsh` 由 `>=0.2.0` 改为 `>=0.2.1-rc.2`：宿主门禁用 `semver.satisfies(…, { includePrerelease: true })`，
`>=0.2.0` 也能被接受；但按 npm **默认**的 SemVer 规则，预发布版本只有在范围中出现同一个 `[major, minor, patch]`
元组且带预发布标签时才可能满足，`>=0.2.0` 因此在默认规则下匹配不了任何 `0.2.1-rc.x` 运行时。DSH 目前只有预发布线，
下界写成 `>=0.2.1-rc.2` 后两种规则都成立，第三方工具（npm 的 `engine-strict`、各种兼容性面板）不会再误判。
代价是 `0.2.0-rc.*` 与 `0.2.1-rc.1` 这些更早的宿主被明确排除 —— 它们本来也不在测试范围内。

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task` | string，**必填** | — | 用户要做什么，一到两行。保留用户原话，非中文任务再补一行英文能力关键词，因为插件元数据大多是英文。 |
| `limit` | integer | `5` | 返回候选条数（1–12）。 |
| `useMarket` | boolean | `true` | 是否包含已配置的插件市场索引；设 `false` 只查本机、不联网。 |
| `includeActive` | boolean | `true` | 是否允许列出已启用的插件；设 `false` 只看需要动作的候选。 |

1. **能力概念表**：约 35 组中英对照概念（语音、翻译、表格、图片、并行、定时、通知……）。任务命中某概念、
   且候选的名称/标题/描述/关键词也命中同一概念时 +6 分。这是中文任务能找到英文描述插件（以及反过来）的关键。
2. **字面重合**：任务分词（英文按词、中文按二字组）落在插件名称 +3、标题 +2、描述或关键词 +1。
3. **同分按状态**：`disabled` → `available` → `active`，可执行的候选排前面。
4. **匹配按词边界**：英文概念词必须从词边界开始，所以 `transcription` 不会触发 `script`、`password` 不会触发
   `word`；中文概念按子串匹配。

插件行的 `config`（在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `promptHint` | `true` | 是否注册系统提示段落 |
| `hintText` | 内置文案 | 整体替换提示段落正文 |
| `limit` | `5` | `limit` 参数的默认值 |
| `useMarket` | `true` | `useMarket` 参数的默认值 |

本插件未声明 `Config` schema，配置对象会被原样读取，字段名写错不会被校验。

- **行级候选（`kind: plugin`）描述的是 profile patch 层**。Agent 预设可能已经自带同一行，此时该能力其实可用；
  只要列了未启用的行，工具就会在结果末尾给出这条提醒。bundle 级候选没有这个问题。
- **市场结果需要先配置索引**。市场 bundle 启用后服务即挂载，但默认不带任何索引源；在添加索引之前，工具会报告
  `market: no index configured` 并退回纯本地结果。
- **市场文本是第三方内容**，不是指令；索引本身未签名，最终装什么由安装后的 manifest 决定。
- **工具不会自行启用或安装**任何东西，那些步骤保留各自的用户批准。

- **不收集、不上报**：插件没有遥测、没有分析上报，不写任何文件，也不在会话之外保存记忆。全部逻辑只在 Host 进程内读内存中的清单。
- **任务描述不会外发**。唯一可能出网的路径是插件市场：Host 会下载你配置的索引文档（一个普通 GET），
  而 `task` 文本只在**本地**用于过滤已下载的文档——市场服务按 URL 缓存文档、在同一 URL 上并发读取共享一次
  请求，查询文字从不进入请求。想完全离线，把 `useMarket` 设为 `false`。
- **会进入会话记录的内容**：匹配到的插件名称、标题、描述，以及本地清单的统计数字。它们会随工具结果写入你
  自己的会话日志（用于回放/分叉），若把会话分享出去，等于公开了本机的插件清单；`includeActive: false`
  可以只列需要动作的候选，减少暴露面。
- **市场文本是第三方内容**，索引本身未签名；它只作为候选呈现，装什么由安装后的 manifest 决定。

`test/harness.mjs` 用假 context 和夹具清单挂载本 bundle，覆盖排序、参数处理、异常处理和配置路径，
不需要 DSH 环境：

```bash
node test/harness.mjs
```

本插件已发布到 npm，会被按 npm 元数据自动收录的市场索引发现。若想在 DSH 的「发现」页里直接搜到整个社区目录，可以加入 **dshmarket 社区目录**的 format-1 索引（dshmarket 官方提供，与它界面里是同一份数据）：

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json
```

DSH → 设置 → 插件 → **发现** → 添加索引，粘贴上面的地址即可。

> 这份目录约 2.2 MiB：在部分网络下会超过市场给单个索引源的 15 秒上限。那种情况下改用**按版本固定**的 CDN 直链会快得多 —— unpkg 只接受精确版本，例如
> `https://unpkg.com/dsh-plugin-catalog@<版本>/index.json`，版本号用 `npm view dsh-plugin-catalog version` 查（目录每天重建，版本号会随之变化）。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-task-plugin-scout) [](LICENSE)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that answers one question
before work starts: **which plugins already available to this profile would make the task at hand easier?**

It registers one model-facing tool, `plugin_scout`, plus a short system-prompt section that reminds the agent
to use it. Given a one-line task description it ranks this profile's plugins — **already active**, **installed
but disabled**, and **installable from the configured market indexes** — and returns the exact next step for
each candidate (enable, install, or nothing).

- Package: `dsh-task-plugin-scout` · loader row: `dsh-task-plugin-scout`
- Host-only bundle: no dependencies, no build step, plain ESM JavaScript
- Changes nobody's state by itself: it only *recommends*; enabling or installing still goes through
  `plugin_manager` and the user's approval

| Part | Name | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Model tool | `plugin_scout` | Ranks plugin candidates for a task and returns each one's next step |
| Prompt section | `plugin-scout:discovery` (order 700) | Tells the agent to scout before starting non-trivial work |

Example result (numbers are illustrative; each run reports its own `Coverage`):

```
Plugin Scout · task: 把开会录音转成文字纪要 (voice, transcription)
Coverage: 3 of the listed candidates need an action to take effect · 48 bundles · 214 plugin rows · 12 market entries · https://example.com/index.json: 12 of 1234

1. 语音输入 [disabled, score 10] — bundle `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`

`state` is one of:

| State | Meaning | Next step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | Already running in this profile | none |
| `disabled` | Installed but switched off (including shipped opt-in bundles) | `set_bundle` / `set_plugin` |
| `available` | Not installed; offered by the Official catalog or a market index | `install_bundle` |

Activation is reported as `application: applied`. Confirm with `cordis_inspect_query`
(`Tool.listTools` should list `plugin_scout`) rather than by reading logs.

| DSH version | Verdict | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | Development and test version | All features exercised |
| `0.2.1-rc.3` | Re-verified, no code change needed | See below (2026-10-25) |
| `0.2.1-rc.4` / `0.2.1-rc.5` | Re-verified again, still no code change needed | See below (2026-10-31) |

1. **API surface.** The same six host packages ship **byte-identical JavaScript** across `rc.3 → rc.4 → rc.5`, and
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh` resolves the same 86 packages on `rc.3` and `rc.5` — **nothing added or removed**, only version
   references changed.
2. **The host's own gate.** The manifest was judged by `rc.5`'s own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` (package version
   `0.2.1-rc.5`): *compatible*.
3. **Real load.** `rc.5`'s `loadProfileDirectory()` composes this machine's desktop profile with this bundle mounted, all
   eight external bundles green.
4. **Live check.** After the host was upgraded to `rc.5` and restarted, the `plugin_scout` tool answered
   (28 bundles / 211 plugin rows / 60 market entries).

1. **Byte-level API comparison.** Every host package this plugin touches — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`,
   `dsh-system-prompt`, `dsh-plugin-manager`, `dsh-plugin-market`, `dsh-plugin-market-index`, `dsh-app-boot` — ships
   **identical JavaScript** in `rc.2` and `rc.3` (the only differences are version references inside `package.json`).
   No touchpoint moved: `ctx.tools.register`, `ctx.systemPrompt.section`, `pluginManager.listBundles/listPlugins`, and
   `pluginMarket.listIndexes/search` keep their fields and signatures (`search` still requires `sort`, `offset`, and
   `limit`, and still answers with `entries` / `total`).
2. **The host's own compatibility gate.** The plugin manifest was handed to the real
   `evaluatePluginCompatibility()` in `rc.3`'s `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot`; the verdict is *compatible* (no unmet DSH
   requirement). That is the very check that makes the host skip an incompatible package while loading a profile bundle.
3. **The bundled harness**: `node test/harness.mjs` passes.

`engines.dsh` moved from `>=0.2.0` to `>=0.2.1-rc.2`. The host gate evaluates ranges with
`semver.satisfies(…, { includePrerelease: true })`, so it accepted `>=0.2.0` too — but under npm's **default** SemVer
rules a prerelease version can only satisfy a range when some comparator shares its `[major, minor, patch]` tuple and
carries a prerelease of its own. `>=0.2.0` therefore matches no `0.2.1-rc.x` runtime under the default rules. DSH ships
only prerelease lines today, so a prerelease floor makes the declaration true under both rule sets and stops third-party
tooling (npm's `engine-strict`, compatibility panels) from misreading it. The cost is that `0.2.0-rc.*` and
`0.2.1-rc.1` are now explicitly excluded — they were never in the tested range anyway.

| Argument | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task` | string, **required** | — | What the user asked for, in one or two lines. Keep the user's own words and add English capability keywords when the task is not in English, because most plugin metadata is English. |
| `limit` | integer | `5` | How many candidates to return (1–12). |
| `useMarket` | boolean | `true` | Include the configured market indexes. Set `false` for a local, offline answer. |
| `includeActive` | boolean | `true` | Whether already-active plugins may be listed. Set `false` to see only candidates that need an action. |

1. **Capability concepts** — about 35 bilingual concept groups (voice, translation, spreadsheet, image,
   parallel work, scheduling, notifications, …). When the task hits a concept *and* a candidate's
   name/title/description/keywords hits the same concept, it scores +6. This is what lets a Chinese task find
   an English-described plugin, and vice versa.
2. **Literal overlap** — the task is tokenized (Latin words, CJK bigrams); a token in the plugin name scores
   +3, in its title +2, in its description or keywords +1.
3. **Tie-break by state** — `disabled` → `available` → `active`, so actionable candidates come first.
4. **Matching is boundary-aware** — ASCII concept forms must start at a word boundary, so `transcription`
   never triggers `script` and `password` never triggers `word`; CJK forms match as substrings.

Optional fields on the plugin row's `config` (a profile `cordis.patch.yml` override):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `promptHint` | `true` | Whether to register the system-prompt section |
| `hintText` | built-in text | Replaces the whole prompt section |
| `limit` | `5` | Default for the `limit` argument |
| `useMarket` | `true` | Default for the `useMarket` argument |
The plugin declares no `Config` schema, so the object is read as-is and a misspelled field is not validated.

- **Row-level candidates (`kind: plugin`) describe the profile patch layer.** An agent preset can already
  mount the same row, in which case the capability is effectively present; the tool prints that caveat
  whenever it lists a disabled row. Bundle-level candidates are not affected.
- **Market results need a configured index.** The service mounts with the market bundle, but ships with no
  index source; until one is added the tool reports `market: no index configured` and falls back to
  local-only results.
- **Market text is third-party content**, not instructions, and indexes are unsigned — the installed manifest
  decides what actually installs.
- **The tool never enables or installs anything** on its own; those steps keep their own approval.

- **Nothing is collected or reported.** No telemetry, no analytics, no files written, no memory kept outside
  the session. All work happens in the Host process against in-memory inventories.
- **The task description never leaves the machine.** The only outbound path is the plugin market: the Host
  downloads the index documents you configured (a plain GET), and `task` is used **locally** to filter the
  already-downloaded document — the market service caches a document per URL, shares one fetch between
  concurrent readers of that URL, and never puts query text into a request. Set `useMarket: false` for a
  fully offline run.
- **What enters the session log**: matched plugin names, titles and descriptions, plus the local inventory
  counts. They are recorded with the tool result in your own session log (for replay and fork); sharing that
  transcript would disclose your installed-plugin list. `includeActive: false` narrows the result to
  candidates that need an action.
- **Market text is third-party content** and indexes are unsigned; it is presented as a candidate only, and
  the installed manifest decides what actually installs.

`test/harness.mjs` mounts the bundle on a fake context with fixture inventories and exercises ranking,
argument handling, error handling, and the config path — no DSH required:

```bash
node test/harness.mjs
```

The plugin is published to npm, so indexes built from npm metadata pick it up automatically. To search the whole
community catalog from DSH's Discover tab, add **dshmarket's community catalog**, which it also publishes as a
format-1 index (the same data its own UI shows):

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json
```

Settings → Plugins → **Discover** → add index, paste the URL above.

> That document is about 2.2 MiB: on some networks it exceeds the 15-second budget DSH gives one index source. In that
> case a **version-pinned** CDN URL is far faster — unpkg serves exact versions only, e.g.
> `https://unpkg.com/dsh-plugin-catalog@<version>/index.json`, with the version from `npm view dsh-plugin-catalog version`
> (the catalog is rebuilt daily, so the version changes).
